summary: Enhance your leadership skills with our Enterprise Information Architecture training course, designed specifically for non-technical leaders. Enroll today!
lede: Enterprise Information Architecture for Non-Technical Leaders helps leaders create a clear framework for how information is defined, organized, accessed, secured, and used. It connects people, processes, data, and technology so leaders can make better decisions about systems, governance, and information flows. You will learn practical ways to map information flows, establish common language, develop metadata and taxonomies, reduce duplication, improve search and retrieval, and support compliance. The course equips you to guide initiatives such as ERP rollouts, SharePoint implementations, cloud transitions, data platforms, and reporting standards without needing to become an architect or engineer.
audienceIntro: This course is designed to empower leaders across various sectors who are responsible for managing information-heavy environments and digital initiatives.
modules: Information Architecture for Leaders: The Big Picture
Understanding Information as an Enterprise Asset
Mastering Business Definitions and Common Language
Governance and Ownership: Who Is Accountable
Measuring Value and Building the Business Case for IA
Working with IT and Vendors Without Getting Lost
Capstone: Your Enterprise Information Architecture Action Plan
prerequisites: No technical background is required, but participants should have experience in leadership roles that involve decision-making about systems, data, or processes.
